sources.title: Best 8GB GPU Model: How to Set Up Qwen 3.5 9B (Step by Step)
sources.snippet: Quick Answer:Qwen 3.5 9B fits in 6.6GB on Ollama, runs natively multimodal (images + video from the same weights), supports 262K context, and beats Qwen 3-class models 3x its size on reasoning. Run `ollama run qwen3.5:9b` and you're done. For 8GB VRAM, use Q4_K_M. For 12GB, step up to Q6_K or Q8_0. Thinking mode is off by default — turn it on for math and coding.
